notes.title: Closed Beta Playtest #3
notes.content:
A playtest for Skeletal Skism 2 will be held next weekend! This will be the final playtest held before the game's release.


When: Saturday, 8/17/24, at 9:00 PM PST

Duration: The playtest will last one week, ending Saturday, August 24, 2024 9:00 PM PST

Rewards: (Participants must be in the Discord server to receive rewards)
- $100 (max.) [Each #1 ranked player on each region's leaderboard will win $25 at the end of the playtest.]
- The @Tester role

How to join: Request for access on the Steam page, and 100 (max,) random people who request will receive access when the playtest begins. If you were already granted access for the last playtest, you do not need to request again.


MBE Games Discord
